contracts.description: Vocabulary lookup; tied LM head for this checkpoint.
Gemma RMSNorm before attention, after attention, and final norm.

Causal width-4 convolution over packed QKV.
Fused Q/K normalization, V layout, decay and beta preparation.
Chunked gated-delta rule and recurrent-state update.
Packed recurrent gated-delta update with persistent state.
Optional recurrent/gating and standalone L2-normalization kernels exposed by the GDN implementation.
RMSNormGated over recurrent output and z gate.
QKV projection, per-head Q/K RMSNorm, partial RoPE and output gate split.
KV-cache update and causal paged attention for six full-attention layers.
Sigmoid output gate followed by row-parallel projection.
Dense gate/up projection, SiLU-and-mul, and down projection.
Final tied LM head and logits processor; sampling is outside this contract.
